narrative.title: The Storage-Bin Checkpoint Map
narrative.scenario: A fulfillment center keeps seven emergency supply bins laid out in a strict hierarchy: one master checkpoint, two wing supervisors beneath it, and four aisle wardens below them. The safety board receives the bin labels as a flat list in top-to-bottom, left-to-right order and must rebuild the physical hierarchy from it. To confirm the rebuild is wired correctly, the inspector walks the structure root-first and records labels as they are visited.
narrative.inputFormat: An array of 7 integers given in level order — index 0 is the root, then its two children, then the four grandchildren.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the preorder traversal (root, left subtree, right subtree) of the constructed tree as an array.
constraints: The array contains exactly 7 integer values

testCases.explanation: Root 1, left subtree {2,4,5} visited root-first, then right subtree {3,6,7}.
Same shape as tc-1 — preorder is root, then the entire left wing, then the right wing.

hintLevels: Level 1: A flat top-to-bottom, left-to-right list hides a two-dimensional family tree — each element is someone's child.
Level 2: For a node sitting at index i of the array, its children live at indices 2i+1 and 2i+2.
Level 3: Recurse on those child indices with an array-bounds guard, then emit the requested visit order from the rebuilt structure.
